credit: Sample sketch drawn for this demo.

objects.label: Sun
objects.sound_prompt: Warm summer morning birdsong with a soft gentle breeze
objects.description: A sun in the top right corner, drawn as a spiky star with ten points. It is a flat yellow wash inside a wobbly ink outline.

objects.label: Puffy cloud
objects.sound_prompt: Soft wind gusting past, a distant low rumble of thunder
objects.description: A puffy cloud near the top of the page, with two tiny birds flying to its right. Its bumpy edge is one wobbly ink line over a pale blue-grey wash.

objects.label: House
objects.sound_prompt: A wooden front door creaking open, then closing softly
objects.description: A small house with a pointed roof, a chimney with a curl of smoke, a front door and two windows. It is filled with a warm orange-brown wash inside a simple ink outline.

objects.label: Tree
objects.sound_prompt: Leaves rustling in a light breeze, a branch creaking
objects.description: A leafy tree with a round crown on a straight trunk. Two short lines inside the crown hint at its branches, and the green wash sits loosely inside the ink.

objects.label: Dog
objects.sound_prompt: A small friendly dog barking twice, tail thumping
objects.description: A small brown dog standing below the tree, facing left with its tail held up. A dot for an eye and a few short lines are all it takes.

objects.label: River
objects.sound_prompt: A shallow stream babbling over pebbles, gentle and steady
objects.description: A river winding down from the horizon on the right, growing wider as it comes closer. Little curved ink marks on the blue wash show ripples on the water.

objects.label: Garden path
objects.sound_prompt: Footsteps crunching slowly along a gravel garden path
objects.description: A garden path running from the front door of the house toward the river. It widens as it comes nearer, and a few ink dots read as pebbles along the way.
